question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).
sql:
-- Check how many are excluded by each filter
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap >= 1
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT 
        r1.race_id,
        r1.driver_id,
        r1.lap AS current_lap,
        r1.position AS current_position,
        r2.lap AS prev_lap,
        r2.position AS prev_position
    FROM race_laps r1
    JOIN race_laps r2 
        ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id 
        AND r1.driver_id = r2.driver_id
        AND r1.lap = r2.lap + 1
),
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(lap AS INTEGER) AS retire_lap
    FROM retirements
),
with_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        c.*,
        CASE WHEN c.prev_lap <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM pit_stop_laps p 
            WHERE p.race_id = c.race_id 
            AND p.driver_id = c.driver_id 
            AND p.pit_lap IN (c.prev_lap, c.current_lap)
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pit,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM retirement_laps r 
            WHERE r.race_id = c.race_id 
            AND r.driver_id = c.driver_id 
            AND r.retire_lap IN (c.prev_lap, c.current_lap)
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retire
    FROM consecutive c
)
SELECT 
    SUM(is_start) as start_excluded,
    SUM(is_pit) as pit_excluded,
    SUM(is_retire) as retire_excluded,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_start = 0 AND is_pit = 0 AND is_retire = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as remaining
FROM with_flags

WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position

),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT

        r1.position AS current_position,
        r2.lap AS prev_lap,
        r2.position AS prev_position
    FROM race_laps r1
    JOIN race_laps r2 
        ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id 
        AND r1.driver_id = r2.driver_id
        AND r1.lap = r2.lap + 1
),
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(lap AS INTEGER) AS retire_lap
    FROM retirements
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        c.race_id,
        c.driver_id,
        c.prev_lap,
        c.current_lap,
        c.prev_position,
        c.current_position,
        c.current_position - c.prev_position AS pos_change
    FROM consecutive c
    -- Exclude first lap changes (start movements)
    WHERE c.prev_lap > 1
    -- Exclude changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stop_laps p 
        WHERE p.race_id = c.race_id 
        AND p.driver_id = c.driver_id 
        AND p.pit_lap IN (c.prev_lap, c.current_lap)
    )
    -- Exclude changes due to retirements

        AND r.driver_id = c.driver_id 
        AND r.retire_lap IN (c.prev_lap, c.current_lap)
    )
)
SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtakes,

FROM filtered
